problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate the sequential inspection of four regional warehouses by a single quality auditor.

The travel times between warehouses are recorded in minutes:
* Warehouse 1 to Warehouse 2: 124.4 minutes
* Warehouse 1 to Warehouse 3: 102.2 minutes
* Warehouse 1 to Warehouse 4: 132.5 minutes
* Warehouse 2 to Warehouse 3: 112.0 minutes
* Warehouse 2 to Warehouse 4: 11.7 minutes
* Warehouse 3 to Warehouse 4: 123.7 minutes

The auditor must devise an itinerary that examines each warehouse precisely once, concluding the tour back at the initial warehouse, while minimizing the total duration of the circuit.
